becd41a97f.q: What was Alan Underwood's first Angel Flight West mission and why did he start flying for the charity?
becd41a97f.a: Underwood's first flight was for an 18-year-old named Bradley diagnosed with Hodgkin's lymphoma who needed treatment at a children's hospital five hours away. Bradley's mother had been driving three times a week (over 30 hours weekly), but Underwood's one-and-a-half hour flight each way was free to the family. After obtaining his pilot's license and seeking ways to help others through flying, Underwood discovered Angel Flight West and joined the organization.
